test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

S L _ _ G S _ _ N G _ _ A N G

options.text: L A N A L S
A N L A S L
A L N A S L
A L A N L S

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: S L _ _ G S _ _ N G _ _ A N G

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) L A N A L S → S L __L__ __A__ G / S __N__ __A__ N G / __L__ __S__ A N G

**Option 2) A N L A S L **→ S L **__A__** **__N__** G / S __**L**__ __**A**__ N G / __**S**__ **__L__** A N G

Here, 'S L A N G' followed a pattern.

Option 3) A L N A S L → S L __A__ __L__ G / S __N__ __A__ N G / __S__ __L__ A N G

Option 4) A L A N L S → S L __A__ __L__ G / S __A__ __N__ N G / __L__ __S__ A N G

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
